title: Two Results
story: Go functions can return more than one value. This is how Go reports errors too.
goal: Write MinMax(xs []int) (int, int) returning the smallest and the largest. Assume xs is not empty.
hints: Start both lo and hi at the first element, then compare each one.
socratic: Why start from xs[0] instead of 0?
What if all numbers are negative and you started at 0?
How does the caller receive two values?
explain: In one sentence: what did you learn from “Two Results”?
